name: SLS Block 1
tagline: Heavy lift for Artemis lunar program
description: NASA’s super-heavy successor to the Space Shuttle stack, sharing its RS-25 engines and SRB heritage. Carried Orion on Artemis I in 2022 and the Artemis II crew around the Moon in 2026; planned to launch crewed missions through Artemis V. The more powerful Block 1B upgrade was cancelled in 2026.
best_known_for: Heavy lift for Artemis lunar program
